en.name: Farro flour
en.summary: Farro flour is milled from emmer, one of the oldest cultivated wheats, with the bran and germ left in — which is where the oil is. The oil is what ends it: this flour goes rancid long before anything else could happen to it. It keeps 3 months in the pantry and 6 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: Three months, sealed, on a dark shelf away from the oven. Worth knowing at the shop: in Italy the name covers three different grains — the small one is einkorn, the medium one emmer, the large one spelt — so the bag you pick up may not be emmer at all. They behave differently in a dough, even though they store identically. Farro flour is usually stone-ground, which leaves visible flecks of bran and a slightly coarse, speckled texture, and those flecks are exactly the material that spoils. Fresh, it smells of hay and hazelnut. Gone over, it smells sharp and faintly of oil paint, and the bitterness carries right through to the baked loaf — so smell the bag before you commit half a kilo of it to a dough.
en.fridge: No refrigerated figure is published for farro flour, so none is given. Cold slows the oil, and a fridge shelf is a workable compromise for a bag you will finish within a season — but only in a container that seals completely. Wholemeal flour takes up damp readily, and a cold bag opened in a warm kitchen pulls water straight out of the air into the flour, which then cakes into lumps you have to sieve out. Given a choice, spend the space on the freezer instead.
en.freezer: Six months at −18 °C (0 °F), which is where a bag bigger than one season's baking belongs. Airtight tub, or a bag inside a bag with the air pressed out, and write on it — stone-ground flours are hard to tell apart by eye once they are cold and dusted with frost. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe far beyond six months; what runs down is flavour, because oxidation carries on even at −18 °C, just slowly enough to make the exercise worthwhile.
en.thawing: Let the container come up to room temperature before you take the lid off, so the flour does not collect condensation. A few spoonfuls can go from the freezer straight into a dough with no difficulty.
spoilage: A sharp, oily or paint-like smell — rancid germ oil, the usual end.
A bitter aftertaste in bread made to a recipe that used to work.
Clumps or a solid cake in the bag, which means moisture got in.
Webbing, larvae or small moths, in which case the whole bag goes out.
tips: Buy a bag you will finish in a season rather than a sack.
Decant into an opaque airtight tub as soon as you open it.
Smell before baking; rancidity shows up before the date does.
Freeze a new bag for a couple of days to kill any weevil eggs.

faq.q: How long does farro flour last?
faq.a: 3 months in an airtight container in the pantry, or 6 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
Yes, 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Seal it airtight, label it, and let it come back to room temperature before opening.

faq.q: How do you tell if farro flour has gone off?
faq.a: Smell it. A sharp, paint-like note means the germ oil has gone rancid, and the bitterness will come through in the bread.

zh.name: 二粒小麥粉
zh.summary: 二粒小麥粉是用二粒小麥——最古老的栽培小麥之一——連麩皮和胚芽一起磨成的，油脂就在胚芽裡。終結它的正是那些油：這種粉一定是先走油耗味，其他事情都還沒發生。常溫可放 3 個月，−18 °C 冷凍則是 6 個月。
zh.pantry: 密封、放在遠離烤箱的暗處，3 個月。挑貨時要知道一件事：義大利語裡的那個統稱其實涵蓋三種穀物——小的是單粒小麥，中的是二粒小麥，大的是斯佩爾特小麥——所以你拿起來的那一包未必真的是二粒小麥。它們在麵團裡的表現不一樣，只是保存方式相同。二粒小麥粉多半是石磨的，粉裡看得到一點一點的麩皮斑，摸起來也略粗；那些斑點正是會先壞掉的部分。新鮮的聞起來像乾草加榛果；走味之後就變得刺鼻、隱約像油漆味，而那股苦會一路留到烤好的麵包裡——所以在把半公斤粉倒進麵團之前，先聞一下那包粉。
zh.fridge: 二粒小麥粉沒有公布的冷藏期限，所以這裡不給。低溫能拖慢油脂，如果這包粉你一季內會用完，冰箱是可行的折衷——但容器必須完全密封。全麥粉很會吸濕，一包冰過的粉在溫暖的廚房裡打開，空氣中的水就會凝進粉裡，結成你之後得過篩挑掉的硬塊。如果只能二選一，把空間留給冷凍更划算。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 6 個月，超過一季烘焙用量的份量就該放這裡。密封盒，或袋子套袋子並壓出空氣，而且要在上面寫字——石磨的各種全麥粉冰過又結上一層白霜之後，用看的分不出來。只要全程沒退冰，安全性遠遠超過六個月；先見底的是風味，因為在 −18 °C 下氧化仍在進行，只是慢到值得這樣做。
zh.thawing: 整罐密封著回到室溫再開蓋，粉才不會沾上凝結的水氣。要用幾匙的話，直接從冷凍加進麵團完全沒問題。
spoilage: 聞起來刺鼻、帶油味或油漆味——胚芽油耗，最常見的結局。
用一向沒問題的配方做出來的麵包，卻有苦的餘韻。
袋子裡結塊或結成硬餅，表示受潮。
出現絲網、幼蟲或小蛾，整袋丟掉。
tips: 買一季內用得完的量，不要買大袋。
拆封後立刻倒進不透光的密封罐。
烤之前先聞；油耗會比日期更早現形。
新買的整袋先冷凍兩三天，把蟲卵殺掉。

faq.q: 二粒小麥粉可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封放常溫 3 個月，或 −18 °C 冷凍 6 個月。

faq.q: 二粒小麥粉可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下 6 個月。密封、貼標籤，開蓋前先讓它回到室溫。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷二粒小麥粉壞了？
faq.a: 聞一下。刺鼻、像油漆的味道就是胚芽油耗了，那股苦會跑進麵包裡。
